result.summary: Reduces wallet unit test execution time by configuring test wallets with a minimal keypool size of 1 instead of the default 1000. It also consolidates duplicated wallet creation helpers across wallet test files into a shared `NewWallet` utility function.
result.problem: Wallet unit test suites repeatedly instantiate mock descriptor wallets that pre-derive large default keypools of 1000 keys, spending unnecessary CPU time during local testing and continuous integration.
evidence: Author benchmarks reported in the PR description show coinselector_tests runtime dropping from 8.26 s to 3.35 s, spend_tests from 0.59 s to 0.18 s, and group_outputs_tests from 0.33 s to 0.12 s.
result.card: This PR speeds up wallet unit test execution by consolidating duplicated test wallet setup into a shared NewWallet helper and setting keypool_size to 1, avoiding the pre-derivation of the default 1000 keys. It reduces test turnaround times for developers and CI runs. The author reports that coinselector_tests run time drops from 8.26 s to 3.35 s, alongside smaller reductions across other wallet test suites.

risk.why: Touches only unit test wallet setup helpers; a bug would cause unit test failures rather than node or consensus regressions.
